verdict.rationale: Kick documents AR through native invoicing: you can create and send invoices and view invoices synced from Stripe, Mercury, and BILL. The Plus plan explicitly lists "AR & AP" alongside an accrual ledger. However, aging reports and per-customer balances are documented only on the AP side (AP aging and vendor balances in Bill Pay), not for receivables. Missing for 10: explicit AR aging report documentation, per-customer receivable balance views, independent or hands-on corroboration.
